summary: Compose deliberately limited light bands to make form readable through graphic value regions.
objective: Eyes, handles and joints remain distinct in both light and shadow; contour thickness is usable at the delivery size.
intent_signals: Combine toon light bands with clear silhouettes
example_prompts: Give a low-poly delivery creature toon lighting without losing the face in shadow.

principles: Compose deliberately limited light bands to make form readable through graphic value regions.
implementation: Keep silhouette geometry smooth or angular as the subject needs; tune band placement around major planes rather than adding unnecessary contours.
Choose a small set of light/shadow values and test them against the palette; optional contour lines should not swallow tiny parts.
Hold a diagnostic light while orbiting the object; in animation inspect transitions so band changes do not distract from the action.
Quantise the diffuse ramp to 2 bands for props and 3 for faces with the terminator at N dot L = 0.45 and a 0.02-wide smoothstep, so the band edge stays clean without aliasing.
Draw the contour with an inverted-hull pass at 1.5 px at 1080p (2.5 px at 2160p), scaled by view distance, and drop the outline entirely on parts smaller than 12 px on screen.
observable_checks: Eyes, handles and joints remain distinct in both light and shadow; contour thickness is usable at the delivery size.

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for Neutral tone mapping at renderer.toneMappingExposure 1.0; re-tune intensities and fog density under a different tone mapping or exposure - ACESFilmic rolls the band edges together and softens the intended step.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with low-poly or smoothly rounded geometry; cel shading and polygon count are separate choices.

defaults.rationale: Neutral tone mapping at exposure 1.0 is chosen deliberately: a filmic curve compresses the top band into the mid band and destroys the hard step that defines the style. The rim at 0.45x key gives the contour a light edge so the 1.5 px inverted hull is not the only thing separating the subject from the background, and the shadow band is a hue-shifted version of the light band rather than a grey multiply so two values still carry colour.

values.value_structure: two bands carry 80% of the frame; the third band is reserved for the focal head or handle
values.saturation_rule: the shadow band is the light band hue-shifted 15 degrees toward blue at 0.8x value, never a grey multiply; non-focal <= 50% saturation

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 5:1; rim ~ 0.45x key so the contour reads without producing a second terminator

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: banded diffuse ramp with a single stepped specular; no normal maps - they break band edges into noise

motion.ease: sine in-out with a 2-frame step at pose ends

values.signature_technique: a 2-3 band diffuse ramp plus a 1.5 px inverted-hull outline and a 0.45x rim that lifts the contour off the flat backdrop
never: an outline thicker than 3 px at 1080p
